description: Fetch readable web content/docs/PDFs. Auto-cleans ads, keeps code/tables. Supports outline mode & sectionId for long docs, BM25 focus, batch URLs (1-3), and startIndex paging.

cache.description: Cache mode: 'default' uses disk Markdown cache; 'reload' forces re-fetching upstream

citations.description: Rewrite inline links as numbered citations and append a '## References' list

extract.description: Extract structured JSON via CSS selectors without LLM

focus.description: Keyword or topic to target. Uses BM25 semantic scoring to rank and extract relevant paragraphs, saving tokens on long pages

focusMode.description: Focus scoring algorithm (default 'bm25'; 'window' keeps ±2500 char slice around first match)

format.description: Content format: 'markdown' (default, keeps headings, code blocks, tables), 'text' (compact plain text), or 'raw' (unprocessed HTML/source)

includeLinks.description: Include extracted links array in metadata

maxChars.description: Max characters to return (default 30000). Use with startIndex for paging

mode.description: Extraction mode: 'full' (default) returns content body; 'outline' returns H1-H4 heading tree with section slug IDs and char estimates — use on long docs to avoid burning tokens

raw.description: (Deprecated: use format='raw') Return raw response body without extraction

readability.description: Force readability parser (default: auto-detected based on content)

retainLinks.description: Inline link style: 'all' (default), 'text' (strip URLs, saves tokens on index pages), 'none'

sectionId.description: Directly extract a specific section by heading slug ID or title (from outline mode). Reads until next same-level heading

selector.description: CSS selector to narrow extraction to a specific DOM subtree

startIndex.description: Character offset to start reading from. Use nextStartIndex from a previous response to page through long content

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL or array of 1-3 URLs to fetch. Array fetches concurrently and splits maxChars budget

urls.description: (Optional alias for url array) Batch URLs (1~3 URLs run concurrently)

name: fetchWebContent
